title: Ordering Coffee
description: Practice polite everyday café requests, customizing drinks, and handling barista follow-up questions naturally.

cards.prompt: Hi there! What can I get started for you?
cards.task: Order a medium iced latte politely.
cards.answer: Could I get a medium iced latte, please?

cards.prompt: Sure thing. Whole milk okay, or would you like an alternative?
cards.answer: Could you make it with oat milk instead, please?

cards.prompt: Got it, oat milk iced latte. Anything else with that?
cards.task: Ask for less ice and half the usual sweetness.
cards.answer: Could I also do light ice and just half-sweet, please?

cards.prompt: No problem! Would you like anything to eat today?
cards.task: Add an almond croissant and ask for it warmed up.
cards.answer: Yes, I'll take an almond croissant too—could you warm it up for me?

cards.prompt: Will that be for here or to go, and how would you like to pay?
cards.task: Say you are staying in and ask to pay by tapping your card.
cards.answer: For here, please—and I'll pay by card if I can just tap.
